edbDesc: A shock wave inclined with respect to the incident upstream flow direction. Occurs when a supersonic flow encounters a corner that effectively turns the flow into itself and compresses. Can be made by placing a wedge into supersonic, compressible flow. Consists of a very thin region across which nearly discontinuous changes in the thermodynamic properties of a gas occur.
title: Oblique Shock Wave
pickWhy: A variant of the shock wave, which goes on the deck's Mach number card.
